verdict.rationale: Metronome documents subscription lifecycle management covering upgrades, downgrades and mid-contract seat-quantity changes, with a pollable edit history. Nothing in the pack describes proration math, partial-period credits, or how those changes appear as invoice line items. Rate-card price changes apply only from the next billing period. Missing for 10: documented proration methodology for mid-cycle changes, partial-period credit handling, invoice line-item breakdown of prorated charges, evidence of penny-level reconciliation, independent corroboration.
